meta.topic:
Create a high-impact, fast-paced 9:16 vertical motion graphics promo reel (55–60 seconds, 60fps) in English showcasing Zof Studio — an open-source AI-directed motion graphics studio powered by React, Remotion, and OpenCode.

Strict Color Palette & Aesthetic:
- Background: #080B11 (deep obsidian dark canvas)
- Primary Text: #F8FAFC (crisp high-contrast white typography)
- Primary Accent: #0EA5E9 (electric sky blue for key buttons, active outlines, and glow accents)
- Secondary Surfaces: #162033 (elevated dark slate cards, panels, and UI containers)
- Highlight Accent: #38BDF8 (bright cyan-sky glow for keyword highlights, badges, and motion trails)
- Typography: Bold, high-contrast modern English kinetic typography in #F8FAFC with #38BDF8 dynamic word highlights, smooth spring physics, and TikTok/Reels safe-zone framing.
- Avoid rigid templates; use custom programmatic React/Remotion animations: code-to-motion morphs, timeline keyframes, 2.5D layered depth cards (#162033), and terminal command animations.

Scene-by-Scene Breakdown (sync strictly with the English spoken script):
- Scene 1 (0–8s | Hook): Split-screen contrast on #080B11 — a cluttered, slow traditional timeline with a spinning loading wheel vs. a sleek #162033 card bordered in #0EA5E9 where "$0.01" slams onto screen in #F8FAFC with a glowing #38BDF8 shockwave.
- Scene 2 (8–18s | The Problem vs. Solution): Spinning clocks ("Hours of manual keyframes") shattering into clean #162033 code cards displaying glowing #38BDF8 TSX/Remotion code that automatically assembles into smooth 60fps motion graphics.
- Scene 3 (18–30s | How It Works): Animated UI mockup of Zof Studio's "Master Mind" prompt box (#162033 surface, #0EA5E9 active border) typing a single idea, triggering a 3-step pipeline: AI Scene Coding -> ElevenLabs Voiceover -> Synced Karaoke Captions.
- Scene 4 (30–44s | Open-Source & Privacy): Terminal window (#162033) typing `zofstudio` and launching `http://localhost:4789` with a sleek #0EA5E9 outlined shield badge ("100% Open Source • Local-First • Free Models Supported").
- Scene 5 (44–54s | The Meta Reveal): Dramatic zoom-out revealing that this exact video currently playing is being rendered inside Zof Studio's Remotion timeline at 60fps, highlighted by a #162033 badge with #0EA5E9 border: "Rendered by Zof Studio itself".
- Scene 6 (54–60s | CTA): Bold final end-card on #080B11 featuring the Zof Studio brand mark, GitHub link `github.com/ZOF478/zofstudio`, and `studio.zoedit.com` framed in #0EA5E9 with a pulsing "What are you waiting for?" callout in #F8FAFC.
